phase_note: Age 26, planning a deep-work year around 30. The next 3–4 years are for accumulation: exhibition history, publishing relationships, peer network, and body of work depth. Tier 1-2 opportunities build this foundation. Tier 4 targets are tracked now, not acted on until the foundation is solid.

readiness_scores.tier_3_readiness_note: Low — more group shows are the most direct path to improving this score.

immediate_priorities.title: HATTIFNATT Koenji Cafe Gallery
immediate_priorities.summary: Koenji storybook-aesthetic cafe known for artists and warm interiors — highest aesthetic alignment with GEGYjiji of any cafe in the dataset.

immediate_priorities.title: UTRECHT
immediate_priorities.summary: Tokyo independent art bookstore with gallery space focused on zines and artist books—low-pressure venue where your work could exist as printed matter alongside exhibition.

immediate_priorities.title: ZINEフェス東京 (ZINE Fest Tokyo)
immediate_priorities.summary: Monthly Tokyo zine fair organized by BOOK CULTURE CLUB — 90cm half-table booth, ¥5,200-6,200 fee, applications close 2 weeks before each event. Next Tokyo date: July 11 2026.

immediate_priorities.title: MOUNT ZINE
immediate_priorities.deadline: Twice-yearly (spring/autumn) — watch @mountzine for autumn 2026 recruitment window
immediate_priorities.summary: Tokyo zine shop near Komazawa University that accepts zine submissions twice yearly (spring and autumn) with no fees and no screening — good Tier 1 ambient visibility target for artist-book and print

immediate_priorities.title: Route Books
immediate_priorities.summary: Ueno bookshop-cafe with a confirmed rental gallery wall — accessible East Tokyo arts venue in the cultural district near Ueno Park.

build_toward.title: Center for Book Arts Opportunities
build_toward.summary: Book arts institution with exhibitions, residencies, education, and opportunities connected to artist books and printed matter.

build_toward.title: Aesthetica Art Prize
build_toward.summary: Annual international art prize open to all media — watercolor / works on paper, works on paper, digital, and more — with strong emerging artist track record.

build_toward.title: Women United ART MAGAZINE Issue XIV Summer 2026
build_toward.summary: International coffee-table print magazine for women artists — all mediums including watercolor, deadline June 10, $25 fee.

watch_list.title: Asian Cultural Council (ACC) 2026 Grant Program
watch_list.deadline: 2025-11-19 (application deadline, EST 9:59 AM); recommendation letters due 2025-11-26
watch_list.summary: ACC provides fellowships and cultural exchange opportunities for Asian artists to explore new cultures and develop their artistic practice internationally, supporting visual artists like watercolor ar

watch_list.title: Northwest Watercolor Society 2026 Annual International Open Exhibition
watch_list.summary: Prestigious annual international watercolor exhibition open to all artists worldwide, $15,000+ in awards, juror Dongfeng Li (Chinese-American watercolor watercolor artist). Deadline July 8 2026.

watch_list.title: Cité Internationale des Arts Artist Residency
watch_list.summary: Major international artist residency in Paris offering studio housing to artists from around the world, with strong track record for Asian artists.

watch_list.title: 「国際創作者駐村計畫」
watch_list.deadline: 2024-12-29 or 2025-09-30 or 2025-06-30 or 2026-04-30 (multiple programs with different deadlines)
watch_list.summary: International artist residency program inviting visual artists, filmmakers, designers and architects for 2026.

watch_list.title: INSTINC 2026/2027 Artist-in-Residence Program
watch_list.summary: Independent artist residency program emphasizing experimentation and artistic vision, open to international artists.

watch_list.title: Royal Watercolour Society Open Exhibition
watch_list.summary: The world's oldest and most prestigious watercolor society, holding annual open exhibitions open to non-member artists internationally.
